instructions.3: Pour the okra mixture into a tagine or Pyrex dish, cover it, and place it in the oven until cooked through.

instructions.1: Blend the onion, bell pepper, tomatoes, vinegar, and garlic in a blender.
instructions.2: Sauté the blended mixture in oil until it reaches a boil over low heat.
instructions.3: Sauté the zucchini thoroughly in this mixture and pour in the broth until it boils.
instructions.4: Reduce the heat and simmer until cooked through.

instructions.1: Grate the zucchini, then sauté it in oil with the minced onion, salt, and pepper.
instructions.2: You can also grate a potato along with a green bell pepper.
instructions.3: Add the broth and milk; once boiling, transfer the vegetables and broth to a Pyrex dish, then top with whisked eggs seasoned with salt and pepper and a knob of butter.
instructions.4: Bake in a medium oven until cooked through.

instructions.1: Peel the zucchini and cut into wide slices.
instructions.2: Grate the onion and rub it with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Sauté the zucchini with the onion in ghee or oil until the pieces hold together.
instructions.4: Add a little water or broth as needed, cover the pot, and cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.5: Lightly grease a Pyrex dish or baking tray with oil, arrange the zucchini in it, and mix with half of the bechamel sauce.
instructions.6: Whisk the egg into the remaining half of the bechamel sauce, pour it over the dish, and sprinkle the top with fine breadcrumbs and a knob of butter.
instructions.7: Bake in a medium oven until cooked through and the top is golden brown.

vl20-3.name: milk
vl20-3.standardAmount: approx. 3 cups, depending on desired consistency

instructions.1: Melt the ghee or oil and add the flour, stirring constantly over low heat until it turns golden, then remove from heat.
instructions.2: Bring the milk to a boil and add it to the flour mixture, whisking rapidly with a wire whisk.
instructions.3: Return the pot to low heat, stirring continuously, then season with salt and pepper until the desired consistency is reached.
instructions.4: Once the mixture has cooled slightly, add the eggs.

instructions.1: Peel the zucchini and parboil them in a little boiling water.
instructions.2: Drain the water, then slice the zucchini in half lengthwise.
instructions.3: Carefully scoop out the centers and arrange them in an oiled baking dish or Pyrex.
instructions.4: Stuff the zucchini with small pieces of black olives and place them on top of the scooped centers.
instructions.5: Grate the cheddar cheese, place it over the zucchini with a little butter, and bake in the oven.

vl22-2.name: Asag (minced meat mixture) or cooked minced chicken

instructions.1: Peel the zucchini and slice them lengthwise into halves without boiling.
instructions.2: Scoop out the zucchini centers and stuff them with the asag or the minced chicken mixed with the cooked mixed vegetables (carrots and peas) after pulsing them together in a food processor.
instructions.3: Stir a little pasta sauce into the filling, then cover the zucchini with a cup of bechamel and top with shredded cheddar or any preferred cheese.
instructions.4: Lightly grease a baking dish with oil, then arrange the stuffed zucchini in the dish, adding a very small amount of water to prevent sticking.
instructions.5: Cover and bake in a medium oven until cooked, then remove the cover to allow the cheese to melt on top.

instructions.1: Peel the taro and cut into medium cubes; soak in warm water (to remove the mucilaginous texture), then rinse with water and lemon juice.
instructions.2: Blend the onion, green pepper, tomatoes, vinegar, and garlic in a blender.
instructions.3: Heat the oil in a cooking pot until warm, then pour in the blended mixture over low heat until it reaches a boil.
instructions.4: Pour in the broth and bring to a boil.
instructions.5: Add the taro, reduce the heat, and cover the pot until tender.

instructions.1: Peel the eggplant, cut into medium rounds, and place in a colander over a bowl; sprinkle with salt to draw out the moisture, then pat dry.
instructions.2: Heat oil in a frying pan, fry the eggplant on both sides until golden, and drain on paper towels.
instructions.3: Blend the onion, tomatoes, bell pepper, garlic, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a blender.
instructions.4: Prepare a pot with a little oil, pour in the blended mixture, and then add about 1.5 to 2 cups of broth.
instructions.5: Once the mixture boils, arrange the fried eggplant in a Pyrex dish or baking tray, pour the sauce and broth mixture over it, and bake in a medium oven until absorbed and cooked through; you may cover it while baking.

vl25-2.name: minced meat mixture (asaj) (see Bab Al-Lahm recipes)

instructions.1: Peel the eggplant, cut into medium rounds, and place in a colander over a bowl; sprinkle with salt to draw out the moisture, then pat dry.
instructions.2: Heat oil in a frying pan, fry the eggplant on both sides until golden, and drain on paper towels.
instructions.3: Blend the onion, tomatoes, bell pepper, garlic, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a blender.
instructions.4: Prepare a pot with a little oil, pour in the blended mixture, and add about 1.5 to 2 cups of broth.
instructions.5: Once the mixture boils, prepare a Pyrex dish or baking tray; layer the eggplant and minced meat mixture alternately, starting with a layer of eggplant at the bottom, then meat, continuing until the top layer is the meat mixture.
instructions.6: Pour the tomato broth over the layers and bake in the oven until cooked through.
instructions.7: You may add a layer of bechamel sauce (1 cup) on top.

pasta-03.title: Plain Fluffy Rice with Toasted Vermicelli

instructions.1: Sort the rice and wash it thoroughly several times.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee or oil and add a little vermicelli until it turns golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the cup of water, salt, and a tablespoon of vinegar if desired, and bring to a boil.
instructions.4: Add the rice to the boiling water until it is fully absorbed, then reduce the heat to very low, cover, and leave for about half an hour, stirring occasionally until cooked.
instructions.5: The rice can be cooked without vermicelli.

instructions.1: Soak the rice for about one hour.
instructions.2: Prepare a Pyrex dish, lightly grease it with a spoonful of ghee, then add the rice.
instructions.3: Pour the hot milk, seasoned with salt and pepper, over the rice and cover.
instructions.4: Place in a medium-heat oven until it is nearly cooked.
instructions.5: Melt a spoonful of ghee and pour it over the surface of the rice after removing the cover, then leave until fully cooked.

pasta-05.title: Baked Rice in Milk with Chicken or Beef

instructions.1: Cut the meat into cubes or the chicken into quarters, and season well with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Prepare a Pyrex dish and lightly grease it with ghee.
instructions.3: Layer half of the soaked rice in the dish, followed by the cut meat or chicken, then the remaining rice.
instructions.4: Cook following the same steps as the previous Roz Meammar recipe (seasoned hot milk, oven, then ghee on top).

pasta-06.title: Rice with Chicken Liver, Caramel and Toasted Nuts

instructions.1: Sort the rice and wash it thoroughly.
instructions.2: Sauté the chicken liver and gizzards in ghee or oil, then remove and set aside; in the same pan, fry the almonds or hazelnuts, then the raisins until golden, and set them aside.
instructions.3: Prepare a pot with oil or ghee to fry the onion, then pour the broth seasoned with salt, pepper, and spices over it and bring to a boil.
instructions.4: Once boiling, carefully pour the liquid over the caramel, then add the rice, liver, and gizzards, and leave over very low heat until the rice is cooked through.
instructions.5: Pour into a serving dish and garnish the top with the nuts and raisins.

pasta-07.title: Simple Caramel (for Rice with Caramel)
pasta-07.servings: enough for one rice pudding dish

instructions.1: Melt the sugar with the water and lemon juice over low heat until it turns into caramel, then leave it to cool completely and harden.

pasta-08.title: Baked Rice with Assag and Béchamel

pb9-3.name: Minced meat mixture (see Bab al-Lahm section)

instructions.1: Cook the white rice using the fluffy rice method.
instructions.2: Prepare a Pyrex dish and place the cooked rice in it, mixing it thoroughly with the minced meat mixture, then pour the béchamel sauce over it.
instructions.3: Place in a medium-heat oven until the top is golden brown.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee or oil and add the cardamom and mastic to infuse it with flavor.
instructions.2: Add the broth and bring to a boil, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Cut the boiled chicken into small slices.
instructions.4: Add the rice to the broth and stir in the chicken slices.
instructions.5: Leave the rice on low heat without stirring until it absorbs the liquid and reaches a porridge-like consistency.

pasta-10.title: Layered Rice, Peas, Carrots and Assag Timbale

instructions.1: Melt the oil or ghee and sauté the minced onion until it turns golden.
instructions.2: Pour in the broth or water seasoned with salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
instructions.3: Add the rice to the broth or water and leave it over low heat until the liquid is absorbed, then reduce the heat to very low until cooked through.
instructions.4: Boil the peas with salt and pepper, then remove and drain; repeat the same process for the carrots.
instructions.5: Prepare the osaj using the standard method.
instructions.6: Heat oil in a pan and sauté the peas and carrots separately.
instructions.7: Prepare a deep bowl and layer the bottom with osaj, followed by a layer of peas, then rice, then carrots; repeat the layers until all ingredients are used.
instructions.8: Place a round serving plate over the bowl and carefully invert the rice; garnish the top with pine nuts if desired.

pasta-11.title: Fatta (Thareed) with Rice and Garlic-Tomato Sauce

instructions.1: Cook the white rice using the standard method.
instructions.2: Cut the bread into small pieces and toast them in oil or ghee, or bake them in the oven.
instructions.3: Heat the oil or ghee and sauté the garlic until golden, then add the vinegar and stir well over medium heat.
instructions.4: Add the tomato paste diluted with a little broth and stir well with salt and pepper.
instructions.5: Set aside a portion of this sauce in a small bowl to garnish the top of the rice later.
instructions.6: Add the salted broth to the remaining sauce and bring to a boil, then pour it over the toasted bread until it is fully soaked.
instructions.7: Prepare a large serving platter; layer half of the bread, followed by half of the rice, then the remaining bread, and finally the rest of the rice, topping it with the reserved sauce for garnish.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee or oil and sauté the vermicelli until it turns golden brown.
instructions.2: Blend the onion and tomatoes in a blender; tomato paste can be used as a substitute for fresh tomatoes.
instructions.3: In another pot, combine the broth and the onion-tomato mixture, then season with salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
instructions.4: Pour the broth and tomato mixture over the vermicelli and stir well, then reduce the heat; once the vermicelli has absorbed the liquid, lower the heat further until cooked through.
instructions.5: The broth can be replaced with water, provided the amount of ghee or oil is doubled.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee or oil in a pot and sauté the orzo until it turns golden brown.
instructions.2: Blend the onion and tomatoes in a blender; tomato paste can be used as a substitute for the fresh tomatoes.
instructions.3: Add the cups of broth (or water seasoned with salt and pepper, while doubling the amount of ghee or oil) to the onion and tomato mixture in a separate pot and bring to a boil.
instructions.4: Pour the tomato broth over the orzo and stir well, then reduce the heat; once the liquid is absorbed, lower the heat further until cooked through.
instructions.5: After serving the orzo in a dish, garnish it with raisins toasted in ghee.

pasta-14.title: Baked Orzo with Beef in Tomato Broth

instructions.1: Parboil the chopped meat seasoned with salt, pepper, and spices.
instructions.2: Blend the onion and tomatoes in a blender; tomatoes can be replaced with tomato paste.
instructions.3: Pour the broth mixed with the tomato sauce over the orzo and meat in a Pyrex dish.
instructions.4: Place in a medium-heat oven until fully cooked.

instructions.1: Prepare a wide, high-sided pot and fill it halfway with water. Place a steamer basket over it and seal the edges with a layer of dough (flour mixed with water). Set over medium heat until boiling.
instructions.2: Place the couscous in a cheesecloth of appropriate size, fold the edges inward to cover it, then cover with the pot lid. Leave over low heat for 20 to 30 minutes.
instructions.3: Carefully remove the cheesecloth from the steamer. Spread the couscous in a bowl and use a fork to fluff it and separate the grains, then let it rest. Sprinkle with one cup of cold water or broth and gently break up the grains by hand.
instructions.4: Return the couscous to the cheesecloth, place it back in the steamer, cover, and steam a second time for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Remove from the cheesecloth and place in a bowl over low heat. Add ghee as desired and fluff with a fork while hot.
instructions.6: Heat ghee in a pan and sauté the onions, then add the small cubed meat and brown it together. Add the strained tomatoes, salt, pepper, and spices.
instructions.7: Simmer over low heat until the meat is cooked, then add a little water and let it boil until the meat is completely tender.
instructions.8: Serve the hot couscous in a dish topped with the stew, or serve the stew in a separate dish.
instructions.9: Alternatively, instead of the stew, heat ghee and add some tomato sauce or tomato juice seasoned with salt and pepper. Add a little water and simmer until it boils and thickens slightly. Pour the sauce into a small bowl and hot broth into another; serve the couscous with both the broth and the sauce.

pasta-16.title: Pasta in Tomato Sauce with Cheese

instructions.1: Boil a sufficient amount of water with added salt and vinegar, then add the pasta; leave the pot uncovered until cooked, then drain.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee or oil and add the pureed tomatoes (or tomato paste) and cook until done.
instructions.3: Add a little water and season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice or a tablespoon of vinegar, then bring to a boil.
instructions.4: Add the pasta and stir gently, then serve and sprinkle the top with shredded cheese.
instructions.5: Alternatively, you can add a medium onion sautéed in oil, then add the tomato juice or two tablespoons of tomato paste and proceed in the same manner.

pasta-17.title: Pasta with Sautéed Carrots and Peas

instructions.1: Boil a sufficient amount of water with added salt and vinegar, then add the pasta; leave the pot uncovered until cooked, then drain.
instructions.2: Sauté the chopped onion, then add the minced garlic and season with salt, pepper, and bay leaves.
instructions.3: Boil the carrot with a few peas, then pour them over the onion mixture and stir well, then mix thoroughly with the pasta.
instructions.4: Garnish the top with lettuce and arugula leaves.

pasta-18.title: Pasta with Chicken in Alfredo-Style White Sauce

instructions.1: Boil a sufficient amount of water with added salt and vinegar, add the pasta, and leave the pot uncovered until cooked, then drain.
instructions.2: Boil the chicken with onion and spices, remove it from the broth, and cut into very small pieces, then toss in the flour mixed with minced garlic.
instructions.3: Sauté a minced onion in oil, then add the chopped chicken, minced garlic, finely chopped pepper, and vinegar, and stir well.
instructions.4: Add a little broth or water mixed with a little milk and mustard.
instructions.5: Add the pasta and mix well, then prepare a greased Pyrex dish, pour in the mixed pasta, and cover.
instructions.6: Place in the oven at a low temperature for a short time until the liquid is absorbed.

pasta-19.title: Pasta with Melted Cheese and Chicken Sauce

instructions.1: Boil a sufficient amount of water with added salt and vinegar, then add the pasta; leave the pot uncovered until cooked, then drain.
instructions.2: Sauté the minced garlic in oil until it turns golden.
instructions.3: Add the chicken pieces to the garlic and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the processed cheese along with a little milk, cream, and water until the cheese melts and the sauce thickens.
instructions.5: Pour the mixture over the pasta and garnish with olive pieces.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee or oil and toast the pasta, stirring continuously until it turns golden yellow.
instructions.2: Bring the broth or water to a boil with the salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Pour the liquid over the toasted pasta and leave it over low heat until the liquid is absorbed, keeping it covered until cooked through.
instructions.4: Alternatively, you can sauté a small onion and the tomato paste, add them to the boiling broth or water, and then proceed with the cooking process.

pasta-21.title: Pasta with Green Pepper, Tomato and Olives

instructions.1: Boil a sufficient amount of water with added salt and vinegar, then add the pasta; leave the pot uncovered until cooked, then drain.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee or oil and sauté the onion until golden, then add the tomato juice or tomato paste and season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice or vinegar.
instructions.3: Once the tomato sauce has cooked, add the finely chopped pepper and stir a couple of times.
instructions.4: Add the boiled pasta to the sauce and mix well, then garnish with the sliced olives.

instructions.1: Boil a sufficient amount of water with added salt and vinegar, then add the pasta; leave the pot uncovered until cooked, then drain.
instructions.2: Boil the potatoes, grate them, and mix with the beaten eggs that have been well seasoned with salt and pepper, then mix the pasta into this mixture.
instructions.3: Grease a baking dish or Pyrex with ghee or oil, pour in the pasta mixture, and place a piece of butter on top.
instructions.4: Shake the Pyrex well, then place it in a medium-heat oven until the top is golden brown.

pasta-23.title: Chinese-Style Flat Noodles with Chicken and Cabbage

instructions.1: Boil a sufficient amount of water with added salt and vinegar, add the pasta, and leave the pot uncovered until cooked, then drain.
instructions.2: Slice the boiled chicken into strips, thinly slice the small cabbage leaves and bell pepper, and finely mince the garlic.
instructions.3: Heat the oil in a pan, sauté the chicken pieces until browned, then add the vinegar and 1 tsp of soy sauce as desired.
instructions.4: Add the cabbage leaves to the mixture, followed by the spices and vinegar, then add a little more soy sauce mixed with a bit of water to thin it out.
instructions.5: Stir the cabbage in the mixture until softened, then add the bell pepper.
instructions.6: Add the boiled pasta to the mixture along with a little more soy sauce and lemon, adding water and oil as needed.
instructions.7: Citric acid and pepper can be added to taste.

pasta-24.title: Pasta Negresco with Chicken and Béchamel

instructions.1: Boil the pasta and drain.
instructions.2: Shred the boiled chicken into thin pieces, sauté it in butter, and mix thoroughly with the boiled pasta.
instructions.3: Mix half of the bechamel sauce with the pasta and chicken mixture.
instructions.4: Grease a baking dish or Pyrex with oil or ghee and pour in the pasta mixture.
instructions.5: Spread the remaining bechamel over the top of the pasta, add a knob of butter or ghee, and sprinkle with shredded cheese.

instructions.1: Cook the minced meat with the onion, tomato paste, salt, pepper, thyme, sumac, vinegar, and lemon juice, ensuring the mixture remains somewhat liquidy.

pasta-26.title: Layered Lasagna with Assag and Béchamel

instructions.1: Boil the lasagna sheets in 4 liters of boiling salted water for 15 minutes.
instructions.2: Prepare a baking dish greased with oil and a light sprinkle of breadcrumbs.
instructions.3: Begin layering by spreading a layer of bechamel, followed by a layer of minced meat sauce, a sprinkle of Romano cheese, and about 3 lasagna sheets placed lengthwise and half a sheet placed crosswise, depending on the size of the dish.
instructions.4: Repeat the same layering process; for the final layer, start with the minced meat sauce, then the lasagna, then the shredded cheese, and finish with bechamel and a knob of butter on top.
instructions.5: Place in a medium-heat oven for approximately 20 minutes until the top is golden brown.
instructions.6: Cover the dish to ensure it remains soft.

stuff-01.title: Rice Stuffing Mix (for Stuffed Vegetables)
stuff-01.servings: enough to stuff 1 kg of vegetables

instructions.1: Chop the onion, tomatoes, parsley, dill, and mint if using fresh.
instructions.2: Place the vegetables in a blender with the salt, pepper, and spices.
instructions.3: Wash the rice and drain it thoroughly.
instructions.4: Place the mixture in a pot over medium heat with the ghee or oil and lemon juice, and bring to a boil.
instructions.5: Mix the ingredients well with the rice until it is ready for stuffing.
instructions.6: The rice can be replaced with cooked minced meat (see Bab Al Louhoum).

stuff-02.title: Stuffed White or Black Baby Eggplants

instructions.1: Gently soften the eggplants by hand, then carefully slit them open.
instructions.2: Soak them in salted water for about half an hour, then drain.
instructions.3: Stuff them with the stuffing mixture according to the amount of vegetables, leaving a small space at the top of the eggplant unfilled.
instructions.4: Arrange them in a pot and pour in the tomato juice, water, salt, and pepper.
instructions.5: Add the ghee or oil, cover the pot, and cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.6: Add more water as needed during cooking.

instructions.1: Wash the peppers, carefully remove the stems, and remove the seeds.
instructions.2: Stuff with the stuffing mixture, leaving a small space so the stem opening can cover the top.
instructions.3: Arrange them in a pot and pour over the ghee or oil, along with the boiling water or broth seasoned with salt and pepper, if available.
instructions.4: Cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender.

stuff-04.title: Stuffed Zucchini with Rice or Assag

st4-2.name: stuffing mixture (rice-based or meat-based/osag) (see Bab Al Lahm)

st4-6.name: onion, tomato, and celery (for the bottom)

instructions.1: Place slices of onion, tomato, and celery at the bottom of the pot.
instructions.2: Carefully hollow out the zucchini after peeling, then stuff them with the filling mixture.
instructions.3: Arrange the zucchini in the pot and add the strained tomato juice, about half a cup of boiling water, salt, pepper, spices, and ghee.
instructions.4: Cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender.

st5-2.name: minced meat sauce (see Bab Al Louk recipes)

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes, carefully hollow them out, then wash with water and pat dry.
instructions.2: Par-fry the potatoes in oil.
instructions.3: Stuff them with the minced meat sauce and arrange them in a Pyrex dish to cook in the oven, or in a pot to cook on the stovetop.
instructions.4: Pour the tomato juice and the liquid seasoned with salt, pepper, and ghee over them.
instructions.5: Cover the pot and leave over low heat until cooked, or place in a medium-heat oven, covered, until cooked through.

st6-2.name: minced meat sauce with tomato (see Bab Al Lahoum recipe)

instructions.1: Stuff the artichokes with the minced meat sauce, arrange them in a pot, and pour the dam'a sauce over them.
instructions.2: Cover the pot and cook over low heat, or arrange them in a baking dish and place in the oven, covered, until cooked through.
instructions.3: You may top the artichokes with a layer of béchamel sauce if cooking them in the oven.

instructions.1: Sauté the garlic in ghee or oil, then pour in the tomato juice and simmer on low heat until cooked, then add the vinegar, water, salt, and pepper.

st8-2.name: filling mixture (with rice or minced meat sauce - see Bab Al Lahm recipes)
st8-2.standardAmount: 1 cup rice or ¼ kg minced meat sauce

st8-7.name: thinly sliced onion rubbed with salt/pepper, and tomato slices (for the bottom)

instructions.1: Wash the grape leaves repeatedly in cold water, then spread them out and arrange them.
instructions.2: Blanch each batch in boiling water with a pinch of salt, then carefully remove and place in a colander.
instructions.3: Trim the stems of the leaves, then lay each leaf flat with the smooth side facing up.
instructions.4: Place a small amount of the filling mixture on the leaf and roll it tightly like a finger until the mixture is finished.
instructions.5: Line the bottom of the pot with a thin layer of unstuffed grape leaves, along with thinly sliced onions rubbed with salt and pepper, tomato slices, a little chopped garlic, and lemon.
instructions.6: Arrange the stuffed leaves neatly in the pot and pour the lemon juice, ghee, and garlic over them.
instructions.7: Place the pot over low heat and cover for 3 minutes, then pour in a little broth or salted water and cover until cooked through.

stuff-09.title: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls with Dill and Cumin

st9-3.name: stuffing mixture without parsley, mint, or meat (see recipe above)

instructions.1: Remove the outer green leaves, separate the remaining leaves from one another, and wash them carefully.
instructions.2: Boil water seasoned with salt and cumin, drop a quantity of leaves into the hot water, and leave until tender, then remove carefully; repeat until all leaves are processed.
instructions.3: Stuff each leaf with a small amount of the stuffing mixture.
instructions.4: Roll them into finger shapes, ensuring the smooth side faces outward.
instructions.5: Arrange them neatly in a pot and place over low heat for 5 minutes.
instructions.6: Pour the tomato juice and a little broth or salted water over them.
instructions.7: Leave over medium heat until nearly cooked, then reduce the heat until fully tender.

stuff-10.title: Savory Qatayef Stuffed with Assag or Shakshuka

st10-2.name: Minced meat mixture or shakshuka (see Bab Al Louk or the following recipe)

instructions.1: Place a portion of the filling inside the qatayef, then fold them in half, pressing the edges together until they stick.
instructions.2: Fry in hot ghee or oil, then remove and place on paper towels.
instructions.3: Sprinkle with grated cheese and serve.
instructions.4: Qatayef can also be stuffed with cheese and butter mixed with chopped arugula.

instructions.1: Grate the onion and sauté in ghee or oil until golden, then add the finely chopped bell pepper and stir just twice.
instructions.2: Whisk the eggs and season well with salt, pepper, and spices, then pour over the onion and pepper over medium heat, stirring until the vegetables and eggs are combined and set.

bake-02.title: Phyllo Pie with Assag and Milk-Egg Custard

bk2-4.name: Asaj (seasoned minced meat; see Meat section)

instructions.1: Prepare the phyllo by placing half of it in a tray lightly greased with ghee.
instructions.2: Spread the asaj over half of the phyllo, then cover it with the remaining phyllo sheets.
instructions.3: Cut the pastry into pieces before putting it in the oven and pour the ghee over it.
instructions.4: Place in a medium-heat oven for approximately half an hour until the phyllo turns golden yellow.
instructions.5: Boil the milk and season it with salt, pepper, and spices; once cooled, add the well-beaten eggs.
instructions.6: Pour the milk and egg mixture over the phyllo along with a tablespoon of ghee, and leave it in the oven until the top browns, then cover it and turn off the oven.

bk3-3.name: Beef shawarma filling (refer to Meat Gate recipe)

instructions.1: Lightly grease a baking tray with ghee, then layer the phyllo sheets one by one, brushing each with a little broth mixed with oil or ghee.
instructions.2: Spread the filling over half of the phyllo layers.
instructions.3: Layer the remaining phyllo sheets using the same method, brush the top with ghee, and cut into pieces.
instructions.4: Once fully cooked and the top is golden brown, pour one cup of cold broth over it.
instructions.5: Leave it inside the oven until it absorbs the liquid, then cover it and turn off the oven.

instructions.1: Prepare a greased baking dish and layer half of the phyllo dough, then add the cream, followed by the remaining half of the phyllo dough, and top with the ghee, then cut into pieces.
instructions.2: Bake in a medium-heat oven until golden brown.
instructions.3: Pour the cold milk or cold broth over it and let it sit until the liquid is fully absorbed, then cover it and turn off the oven.

bake-05.title: Savory Custard Cream with Lemon Zest and Cold Cuts

bk5-8.name: salt, pepper, spice, cinnamon, and cloves

instructions.1: Bring the milk to a boil and add the spices and the washed lemon zest.
instructions.2: Whisk the eggs with the flour until well combined, then add to the hot milk while whisking continuously over low heat, then stir in the parsley.
instructions.3: Increase the heat and add the luncheon meat pieces.

bk6-7.name: lemon juice and vinegar
bk6-7.standardAmount: juice of 1/2 lemon + a little vinegar

instructions.1: Rub the ghee with the oil until well combined, then mix in the flour, and crack the eggs over the mixture and rub them together thoroughly.
instructions.2: Squeeze the lemon juice into a little water and pour it over the mixture until a soft dough forms, adding more water as needed, then cover and let rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.3: Lightly grease a baking tray with ghee or oil.
instructions.4: Roll out the dough on a dry surface dusted with flour, then stuff it with an appropriate amount of cheese mixed with butter.
instructions.5: Cut the dough into shapes using a cup, folding the edges to seal the filling inside.
instructions.6: Arrange them in the tray, brush the tops with egg, and bake in a medium oven until the tops are golden brown.

bake-07.title: Phyllo Pie with Chicken, Vegetables and Béchamel

bk7-11.name: salt, pepper, mixed spices, cinnamon, and thyme

instructions.1: Grate the carrot and pepper, then dice the onion into small cubes.
instructions.2: Sauté the onion in oil or ghee, add the minced garlic, stir, and remove from heat.
instructions.3: Mix the grated carrot and pepper with the boiled peas and season with all the spices; add the curry and pieces of olives, then mix everything with the onion and garlic mixture.
instructions.4: Mix the bechamel sauce with the small pieces of boiled chicken.
instructions.5: Pour the bechamel over the vegetable mixture and stir well.
instructions.6: Grease a baking tray with ghee and layer half of the phyllo pastry, lightly brushing it with ghee.
instructions.7: Spread the bechamel mixture over the pastry, cover with the remaining phyllo, top with 1 tablespoon of ghee, and cut into pieces.
instructions.8: Bake in a medium-heat oven until the top is golden brown.
instructions.9: Once cooked, pour the cup of cold milk (seasoned with salt and pepper) over the dish and let it absorb; then cover it and turn off the oven.

bk8-2.name: shakshuka (see recipe in the fillings section)

instructions.1: Grease a baking tray with ghee and layer half of the phyllo pastry, lightly brushing each layer with ghee.
instructions.2: Spread the shakshuka over the pastry, cover with the remaining half of the phyllo, top with 1 tablespoon of ghee, and cut into pieces.
instructions.3: Place in a medium-heat oven until the top is golden brown.
instructions.4: Once cooked, pour the cold milk (seasoned with salt and pepper) over the pastry and let it soak up the liquid, then cover it and turn off the oven.

bake-09.title: Ruqaq — Layered Flatbread with Assag in Broth

instructions.1: Bring the broth to a boil and keep it on very low heat until the pastry is assembled; add 1 tablespoon of ghee and season with pepper and spices.
instructions.2: Prepare a tray greased with ghee, then place the first layer of roqaq sheets, being careful not to dip the bottom of the sheets into the broth so they do not stick to the tray.
instructions.3: Moisten only the top surface with the hot broth.
instructions.4: Take the sheets one by one and lightly moisten both sides with the hot broth, being careful not to let the pastry break, and layer them in the tray until half the quantity is used.
instructions.5: Spread the minced meat filling over the layer, then begin layering the remaining roqaq sheets moistened with the boiling broth until finished.
instructions.6: Brush the top of the tray with ghee and place in a medium-heat oven until the top turns golden brown.
instructions.7: Carefully flip the pastry onto the other side and return to the oven until the other side is golden brown.
instructions.8: Immediately cover the pastry after removing it from the oven to keep it soft.

des-03.title: Simple Pancakes with Molasses or Jam

instructions.1: Add the baking powder to the flour, then mix with the oil and vanilla, gradually adding milk until the batter reaches a medium-soft consistency.
instructions.2: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan, then pour one tablespoon of the mixture into the oil or butter; flip on both sides until golden, repeating the process one by one.
instructions.3: Once the batter is finished, place the pancakes on a flat plate and begin decorating them.
instructions.4: Top with a little butter and black honey or jam; you can also add a layer of custard and nuts.

des-04.title: Chocolate Caramel Pancake Stack with Strawberries

instructions.1: Melt the butter with the milk in a saucepan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Mix the flour with the baking powder, then add them to the sugar and combine.
instructions.3: Whisk the eggs and vanilla into the milk and butter mixture, then pour the liquid into the flour and sugar mixture and whisk with a wire whisk.
instructions.4: Place the batter in the refrigerator for about 45 minutes.
instructions.5: Prepare a non-stick pan with a little oil and heat it slightly.
instructions.6: Fill a ladle with batter and pour it into the pan until it is full.
instructions.7: Once the batter sets, flip it to the other side until golden brown, then remove and place on a plate.
instructions.8: Lightly grease the pan with oil and repeat the process, stacking the pancakes two at a time in the plate until the batter is finished.
instructions.9: To garnish, spread chocolate caramel on one pancake, place the second pancake on top, then add more caramel on top and surround with strawberries.
instructions.10: Alternatively, garnish by making whipped cream mixed with chopped nuts; spread this on the first layer, cover with the second, and decorate the sides with whipped cream and the center with strawberries and cream.

instructions.1: Place the sugar in a pan with a little water and cook until it turns slightly golden and becomes caramel.
instructions.2: Add the cream to the caramel, stirring over low heat until completely melted, then add the grated chocolate.

instructions.1: Combine the baking powder and flour, then add half of the sugar and mix well.
instructions.2: Melt the butter in a pan, add the sliced apples and the remaining half of the sugar, cook until the apples are soft and absorb the mixture, then set aside to cool.
instructions.3: In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the buttermilk and vanilla, then add the flour all at once and mix slightly.
instructions.4: Prepare a Pyrex dish and arrange the apple pieces inside, topping them with orange zest.
instructions.5: Pour the batter over the apples without stirring, then refrigerate for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Bake in a medium-heat oven, keeping an eye on it as it cooks quickly.
instructions.7: Invert the pancakes onto a serving plate.

des-07.title: Fried Sweet Fatayer with Sugar or Honey

instructions.1: Add the baking powder to the flour, rub well with the ghee, and add the water as needed.
instructions.2: Cover the mixture and let it rest for about fifteen minutes.
instructions.3: Shape the dough into small lemon-sized balls, then flatten them on a board or tray until they are very thin, about the size of a tea saucer.
instructions.4: Heat plenty of oil in a wide pan and fry the pieces one by one, then place them on a rectangular plate.
instructions.5: Sprinkle the pieces with powdered sugar, white honey, or black honey.

des-08.title: Apricot Jam Lattice Tart (Pasta Frolla Style)

instructions.1: Combine the baking powder and a pinch of salt with the flour and ghee, rubbing them together well with your fingertips.
instructions.2: Beat the eggs with the vanilla, add the sugar, and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the flour mixture to the egg and sugar mixture, mixing well until a medium-soft dough forms.
instructions.4: Place the dough in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Lightly grease a baking pan with butter and press two-thirds of the dough into the pan, covering the sides.
instructions.6: Spread the apricot jam (or any fruit preserve) over the base.
instructions.7: Cut the remaining third of the dough into strips and lay them over the jam in a lattice pattern.
instructions.8: Brush the surface with beaten egg and bake in a medium-heat oven until golden and cooked through.

des-09.title: Phyllo Pie with Custard and Nuts

instructions.1: Lightly grease the baking tray and place half of the goulash sheets inside without cutting them.
instructions.2: Spread the filling over the goulash, then sprinkle with the chopped nuts, raisins, and coconut.
instructions.3: Cover with the remaining goulash sheets, then heat the 1/2 cup of oil or melted ghee thoroughly and pour it over the dough before placing it in the oven.
instructions.4: When it is nearly done, pour the cup of cold milk over it; there is no need for heavy cream to avoid making it too rich.
instructions.5: Return it to the oven for a short time until all the liquid is absorbed and the top is golden brown.
instructions.6: Immediately after removing from the oven, sprinkle with powdered sugar and cover.

instructions.1: Whisk the eggs, then add two tablespoons of milk and mix. Add the cornstarch and whisk well with the cinnamon and vanilla.
instructions.2: Boil the milk with the sugar, then pour a little of the hot milk into the egg mixture (to help it dissolve smoothly), then pour the mixture back into the boiling milk. Whisk well over low heat until the consistency thickens.

des-11.title: Phyllo Pie with Milk and Molasses

instructions.1: Lightly grease the baking tray and layer all the goulash sheets inside without cutting them.
instructions.2: Heat the half cup of oil or ghee thoroughly, pour it over the goulash, and place in a medium-heat oven.
instructions.3: As it nears completion, pour the large cup of cold milk mixed with cream over the pastry.
instructions.4: Return it to the oven until the liquid is absorbed and the top is golden, then cover immediately after removing from the oven.
instructions.5: Serve this pie hot with black honey for dipping.

des-12.title: Sweet Ruqaq with Nuts, Raisins and Cinnamon

instructions.1: Grease a baking tray thoroughly with ghee, place the first dry layer of roqaq sheets, then moisten half of the sheets one by one with water or milk and layer them in the tray.
instructions.2: Spread the chopped nuts, raisins, and cinnamon over the first layer of roqaq.
instructions.3: Cover the filling with the remaining half of the roqaq sheets and brush the top with ghee.
instructions.4: Place in a medium-heat oven until halfway cooked, then carefully flip the tray to cook the other side.
instructions.5: Once fully cooked, turn off the heat, pour the cup of milk and a little cinnamon over the pastry, then cover it and return it to the oven until the pastry softens.

instructions.1: Prepare a bowl and add the flour and salt.
instructions.2: Whisk the eggs with the milk and vanilla, then pour the mixture over the flour and stir well with a wooden spoon until a smooth, liquid batter forms.
instructions.3: Prepare a Teflon pan and add a little oil.
instructions.4: Fill a small cup or a large spoon with the batter and carefully pour it into the hot pan, spreading it to form a thin disc.
instructions.5: Shake the pan and flip the crepe like a cannoli or omelet to cook the other side until it sets and turns golden.
instructions.6: Remove from the pan and place on a plate, repeating the process until all the batter is used to create thin crepes.
instructions.7: Fill each crepe with an amount of jam, then roll them up like a roll and arrange them on a serving plate.
instructions.8: Dust with powdered sugar on all sides and sprinkle with crushed nuts, raisins, and coconut.
instructions.9: You can also add a little whipped cream on top of the powdered sugar.

des-14.title: French-Style Apple Tart with Custard Glaze

instructions.1: Lightly grease a round Pyrex dish with butter, then spread the puff pastry, leaving a 2 cm border at the edges, and prick the surface with a fork.
instructions.2: Peel the apples and cut each into 8 slices, then arrange the apple slices over the pastry.
instructions.3: Sprinkle 3 tablespoons of sugar over the apples and bake in the oven for about 30 minutes.
instructions.4: Whisk the egg, cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla together thoroughly with a whisk.
instructions.5: Remove the Pyrex from the oven, pour the egg and cream mixture over the apples, and return to the oven until golden brown.

db16-8.name: minced meat, Rumi cheese, or white cheese with mint

instructions.1: Mix the yeast with a little sugar, then gradually add the warm water and let it sit until activated.
instructions.2: Beat the eggs well, then gradually add the flour until a somewhat firm dough forms.
instructions.3: Add the yeast mixture to the dough along with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt, then mix well.
instructions.4: Roll out the dough on a floured surface to a thickness of 0.5 cm.
instructions.5: Drizzle the melted ghee over the surface until absorbed, then roll or fold it like a pastry and let it rest.
instructions.6: Roll it out a second time, then cut and shape it into triangles.
instructions.7: Fill with either minced meat, Rumi cheese, white cheese with mint, or leave plain.
instructions.8: Roll each triangle into a crescent shape and place on a greased baking sheet, then let rise.
instructions.9: Brush the tops with egg wash or sweetened milk.
instructions.10: Bake in a high-temperature oven until golden brown and cooked through.

db17-5.name: nuts, raisins, coconut, and grated chocolate (optional)

instructions.1: Whisk one egg in a deep bowl with a pinch of vanilla thoroughly.
instructions.2: Place the slice of toast in the mixture and let it soak for a moment, then carefully flip it to the other side until the egg is fully absorbed.
instructions.3: Heat the butter or ghee in a small non-stick pan, carefully place the toast in the pan over low heat, and flip carefully until both sides are golden without burning.
instructions.4: Prepare a plate sized to the toast and sprinkle it with powdered sugar, place the toast on the plate, and sprinkle more powdered sugar on top.
instructions.5: Nuts, raisins, coconut, or grated chocolate can be added over the powdered sugar.
instructions.6: The toast can also be garnished by melting apricot jam with a little water over low heat, then mixing in finely chopped fruits like apples, pears, or dates with a little butter, and pouring the mixture over the toast; alternatively, garnish with caramel, grated chocolate with chopped fruit or ice cream, or cook apples with cinnamon and sugar and pour the sauce over the toast.

instructions.1: Dissolve the cornstarch in about half a cup of cold milk.
instructions.2: Place the remaining milk over medium heat and sweeten with sugar until it reaches a boil.
instructions.3: Take about one large ladle of the boiling milk and pour it into the cornstarch mixture, stirring well to combine.
instructions.4: Pour this mixture into the rest of the boiling milk, stirring well after removing from the heat.
instructions.5: Return the mixture to low heat for approximately 3 minutes while stirring constantly.
instructions.6: Add the vanilla, then pour the pudding into small molds lightly moistened with cold water.
instructions.7: Leave to cool, then garnish with nuts and raisins, or pistachios, coconut, sliced bananas, strawberries, or cherries.
instructions.8: Can also be garnished with whipped cream topped with fruit or nuts, or served with ice cream.

instructions.1: Dissolve the cornstarch in about half a cup of cold milk.
instructions.2: Place the remaining milk over medium heat and sweeten with sugar until it reaches a boil.
instructions.3: Dissolve the chocolate or cocoa powder into the sweetened milk.
instructions.4: Take about one large ladle of the boiling milk and pour it over the cornstarch mixture, stirring well until smooth.
instructions.5: Pour this mixture into the rest of the boiling milk, stirring well after removing from the heat.
instructions.6: Return the mixture to low heat for approximately 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
instructions.7: Add the vanilla, then pour the pudding into small molds lightly moistened with cold water.
instructions.8: Leave to cool, then garnish with nuts and raisins, pistachios, coconut, sliced bananas, strawberries, or cherries.
instructions.9: Garnish with grated chocolate, nuts, or chocolate ice cream.

des-19.title: Jelly with Fresh Fruit and Biscuits

instructions.1: Dissolve the jelly powder in boiling water, stirring well until completely dissolved; you may add a little sugar if desired, then set aside to cool.
instructions.2: In a deep bowl or large serving dish, combine the crushed biscuits and chopped fruit, then pour in the jelly and mix well.
instructions.3: Place in the refrigerator until set firmly.
instructions.4: Garnish with whipped cream, liquid caramel, or custard with coconut.

instructions.1: Prepare small bowls or cups by lightly wetting them with water.
instructions.2: Crush some biscuits as desired and place them at the bottom of the bowls.
instructions.3: Dissolve the cornstarch in about half a cup of cold milk; place the remaining milk over medium heat and sweeten with sugar until boiling.
instructions.4: Dissolve the chocolate or cocoa powder into the sweetened milk.
instructions.5: Take about one large ladle of the boiling milk and pour it into the cornstarch mixture to loosen it, stirring well; then pour this mixture into the rest of the boiling milk, stirring well after removing from heat.
instructions.6: Return the mixture to low heat for approximately 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
instructions.7: Add the vanilla, then pour the pudding over the biscuits.
instructions.8: Once cooled, top with grated or finely chopped chocolate. You can also sprinkle the surface with nuts, raisins, or coconut.

instructions.1: Mix the corn flour with a little milk thoroughly.
instructions.2: Warm the remaining milk in a pot over low heat, then pour the flour mixture into the milk and stir for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Remove the mixture from the heat and add the butter, molasses, sugar, and baking powder, stirring well until the butter is completely melted.
instructions.4: Whisk the egg with the vanilla, then pour it over the pudding mixture.
instructions.5: Grease a small Pyrex dish with butter, pour in the mixture, and pour the remaining milk over the top.
instructions.6: Place the dish in a large tray filled halfway with hot water (water bath) and bake in a very low oven, ensuring you add more water if the level drops in the tray.
instructions.7: Continue baking for about two hours until the top is golden brown.

instructions.1: Dissolve the cornstarch in a small amount of cold milk.
instructions.2: Boil the remaining milk, then temper the cornstarch mixture by adding a little hot milk to it; pour the mixture back into the boiling milk while stirring constantly, then add the coconut.
instructions.3: Add the semolina to the mixture, stirring continuously and rapidly with a whisk over low heat for 10 minutes until the consistency thickens slightly.
instructions.4: Add the sugar and vanilla or mastic, continuing to stir until the sugar dissolves, then let it cool before placing it in the refrigerator.
instructions.5: Prepare a Pyrex dish to pour the pudding into, then garnish with whipped cream and top with banana or strawberry slices.
instructions.6: It can also be garnished with nuts, raisins, and coconut.

instructions.1: Dissolve the cornstarch in a little bit of cold milk.
instructions.2: Boil the remaining milk, then add a small amount of it to the cornstarch mixture and stir; pour the mixture back into the boiling milk while stirring constantly.
instructions.3: Add the semolina to the mixture, stirring continuously and rapidly with a whisk over low heat for 10 minutes until the consistency thickens slightly.
instructions.4: Add the sugar and vanilla or mastic, continuing to stir until the sugar is completely dissolved.
instructions.5: Prepare a Pyrex dish, layer the cold caramel at the bottom, pour the basbousa pudding on top, and place in the refrigerator.
instructions.6: When serving, you can either flip the pudding onto a serving plate or leave it in the Pyrex dish as is, depending on preference.

instructions.1: Melt the sugar with the water over low heat.
instructions.2: Add the lemon juice and continue cooking until the color turns golden brown and becomes caramel.
instructions.3: You can add more water if needed to prevent the caramel from drying out.

db26-6.name: fruit, nuts, cream, whipped cream, or ice cream

instructions.1: Boil the washed rice in a pot of boiling water over low heat until cooked through but still firm.
instructions.2: Drain the rice completely using a strainer.
instructions.3: Boil the milk with sugar, then add the rice; lower the heat and stir for about 5 minutes until it thickens and is no longer runny, then remove from heat.
instructions.4: If the consistency is still too liquid, mix one tablespoon of cornstarch with a little cold milk, pour it over the rice mixture, and return to heat, stirring constantly until the desired consistency is reached.
instructions.5: Add the vanilla and remove the mixture from the heat.
instructions.6: Prepare bowls or cups moistened with water and fill them with the mixture to cool.
instructions.7: Garnish with nuts, raisins, or coconut, or top with cream or whipped cream; you can also add sliced fruit (especially banana) or ice cream.

db27-6.name: cream, nuts, whipped cream, and ice cream

instructions.1: Soak the rice for about 45 minutes, then drain it from the water.
instructions.2: Melt a knob of butter in a pot, add the rice, and stir until it absorbs the butter; then add just enough hot water to cover the rice, lower the heat, and cover until the water is absorbed.
instructions.3: Begin pouring 3 cups of milk over the rice, sweetening it with the sugar, vanilla, and mastic.
instructions.4: Lower the heat and stir occasionally for 10 minutes, leaving the pot lid slightly ajar.
instructions.5: Add the remaining 2 cups of milk; if the rice is not fully cooked, cover the pot completely and stir occasionally, ensuring the rice does not absorb all the milk.
instructions.6: Allow to cool, then place in the refrigerator.
instructions.7: Garnish with coconut, raisins, nuts, whipped cream, or ice cream.

des-27.title: Rice Pudding with Dried Fruit and Orange

instructions.1: Boil the washed rice in a pot of boiling water over low heat until cooked but not mushy, then drain completely.
instructions.2: Boil the milk with sugar, add the rice, and lower the heat, stirring for about 5 minutes until it reaches a good thickness, then remove from heat.
instructions.3: Add the vanilla and remove the mixture from the stove; once cooled, stir in the orange zest.
instructions.4: Place enough water in a dish to cover the dried fruit and add sugar.
instructions.5: Leave the fruit on low heat, adding water whenever necessary.
instructions.6: Before the fruit is fully cooked, add the orange juice until it is fully absorbed, then let it cook until tender and the sugar level is balanced.
instructions.7: Prepare a Pyrex dish, layer the fruit at the bottom, then pour the rice pudding over it; once cooled, place in the refrigerator.
instructions.8: Prepare a serving plate and invert the mixture onto it so the fruit is on top.

instructions.1: Boil the washed rice in a pot of boiling water over low heat until cooked but not mushy, then drain completely.
instructions.2: Boil the milk with sugar, add the rice, and lower the heat while stirring for about 5 minutes until it reaches a good thickness and is no longer liquid, then remove from heat.
instructions.3: Add the vanilla and remove the mixture from the stove.
instructions.4: Once cooled, carefully place the mixture over the caramel and refrigerate.
instructions.5: Prepare the serving dish, swirl the edges of the rice with the caramel, and then pour into the serving dish.

des-29.title: Baked Sweet Rice Pudding with Clotted Cream

instructions.1: Place the rice in a bowl after washing it thoroughly and draining it well.
instructions.2: Boil the milk with sugar until the sugar dissolves, then pour the mixture over the rice, cover, remove from heat, and let it sit for 4 hours.
instructions.3: Grease a Pyrex dish with ghee, transfer the rice into it, top with cream and a piece of ghee or butter, then bake in the oven until the top is golden brown.

instructions.1: Combine the milk and sugar in a pot and heat over the stove until the sugar dissolves and the mixture reaches a boil.
instructions.2: Whisk the eggs with the vanilla, then mix them with the milk once it has cooled.
instructions.3: Allow the caramel to harden, then carefully pour the egg and milk mixture over it.
instructions.4: Place in a medium-heat oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour using a water bath: fill a baking tray halfway with boiling water and place the mold inside to bake until done.
instructions.5: To test for doneness, dip a knife blade into the surface of the mixture; if it does not stick, it is done.
instructions.6: Place in the refrigerator until completely cooled.
instructions.7: Prepare a round serving plate and gently jiggle the sides of the crème caramel, then invert the plate over it to release.
instructions.8: You can use a hot water bath to loosen the mold so it can be moved and flipped easily.

des-31.title: Balila — Sweet Boiled Wheat with Milk

instructions.1: Sort the wheat and wash it thoroughly, then soak it in a bowl of water for about 6 hours or more, then drain the soaking water.
instructions.2: Place the wheat in a pot with water and bring to a boil, then lower the heat until the wheat is completely tender, adding more water as needed.
instructions.3: Sweeten with sugar and serve hot.
instructions.4: Alternatively, sweeten with sugar and add hot milk along with the piece of butter.

des-32.title: Ashura — Sweet Wheat Pudding with Nuts and Cinnamon

instructions.1: Sort the wheat and wash it thoroughly, then soak it in a bowl of water for 6 hours or more, then drain the soaking water.
instructions.2: Place the wheat in a pot with water and boil; once boiling, lower the heat and cook until the wheat is completely tender, adding water as needed.
instructions.3: Mix the cornstarch well with a little water, then add it to the mixture while stirring constantly; cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, adding water or milk if needed, ensuring the Ashura reaches a thick consistency.
instructions.4: Add the vanilla, nuts, and raisins to the mixture.
instructions.5: Ladle into bowls or cups moistened with water and let them sit until completely cooled.
instructions.6: Garnish the surface with cinnamon powder, chopped nuts, and coconut, then serve cold.
instructions.7: Alternatively, after cooking and cooling the Ashura, you can blend it in a mixer and strain it to remove the husks before garnishing.

instructions.1: Cut the apricot leather into pieces and soak in hot water for a long period until soft, then blend in a food processor.
instructions.2: Place the strained apricot mixture in a pot, sweeten with sugar, and stir until dissolved, then let it simmer over low heat.
instructions.3: Mix the cornstarch with a little cold water, then add it to the boiling apricot mixture while stirring constantly over low heat; cook for 5 minutes until it reaches a thick, pudding-like consistency.
instructions.4: Prepare bowls or cups moistened with water, pour the mixture into them, and garnish the tops with nuts, raisins, and coconut.

des-34.title: Baked Sweet Potato Tray with Nuts and Syrup

instructions.1: Boil the sweet potatoes and mash them thoroughly with a fork.
instructions.2: Grease a Pyrex dish with butter or melted ghee, then spread half of the mashed sweet potatoes, ensuring no gaps are left.
instructions.3: Layer the nuts on top along with half of the cinnamon and half of the coconut.
instructions.4: Spread the remaining half of the sweet potatoes on top, then sprinkle with the rest of the nuts, coconut, and cinnamon, add the piece of butter, and place in the oven.
instructions.5: Prepare a syrup by mixing the sugar, water, lemon, and vanilla, stirring until it becomes somewhat thick.
instructions.6: Once the sweet potatoes are removed from the oven, pour the syrup over them and let them cool.
instructions.7: You can garnish with sliced bananas or grated carrots and more nuts.

des-35.title: Baked Sweet Potato Purée with Clotted Cream

instructions.1: Boil the sweet potatoes thoroughly, then peel and mash them with a fork.
instructions.2: Mix the sweet potatoes with the sugar, cream, and milk, then blend the mixture in a blender.
instructions.3: Grease a baking dish or Pyrex with butter, pour the sweet potato mixture into it, and bake in the oven until cooked through.
instructions.4: Sprinkle the top with sugar, then place the dish under the oven broiler until it turns golden brown.

des-36.title: Candied Pumpkin with White Sauce and Nuts

instructions.1: Peel the pumpkin and cut it into slices, then place in a pot with 1/2 kg sugar and the water.
instructions.2: Simmer over low heat until tender, then drain to remove excess water.
instructions.3: Add egg yolks and vanilla to the white sauce and mix well.
instructions.4: Mix the crushed nuts, raisins, approximately 2 tbsp sugar, and vanilla or rose water.
instructions.5: Grease a baking dish or Pyrex well with ghee, then sprinkle with a thick layer of fine breadcrumbs.
instructions.6: Spread half of the white sauce over the breadcrumbs, then layer half of the pumpkin slices evenly on top.
instructions.7: Spread the filling mixture evenly over the pumpkin layer.
instructions.8: Reverse the order by placing the remaining pumpkin slices over the filling, followed by the rest of the white sauce.
instructions.9: Bake in a low oven until set, cooked through, and the top is golden brown.
instructions.10: Allow to cool, then carefully invert onto a serving plate.

instructions.1: Melt the ghee in a pot, add the flour, then remove from heat and stir well with a wooden spoon.
instructions.2: Place back on low heat for 3 minutes.
instructions.3: Remove from heat again and pour in the boiling milk all at once, whisking rapidly.
instructions.4: Return the pot to the heat on low, stirring constantly for 5 to 7 minutes until it reaches a boil and the flour is cooked, then sweeten with sugar.
instructions.5: Once the sauce has cooled, add the egg yolks and vanilla and mix well.

instructions.1: Blend the fruit juice in a blender and add sugar as needed.
instructions.2: Toss the chosen varieties of fruit in a serving bowl after they have been chopped.
instructions.3: Pour the blended juice over the fruit and chill before serving.

des-39.title: Fresh Fruit Khoshaf with Yogurt or Chantilly Cream

instructions.1: Cut the fruits into appropriate pieces and place them in a bowl.
instructions.2: Whisk the yogurt with the sugar and vanilla using an egg whisk or in a blender for 5 minutes until completely dissolved.
instructions.3: Pour the liquid over the cut fruit and mix well.
instructions.4: The yogurt can be replaced with Chantilly cream.

instructions.1: Place the fresh fruit, such as peaches, in a pot, cover with water, and place over the stove.
instructions.2: Add sugar to sweeten the mixture.
instructions.3: Simmer over low heat until the fruit is cooked through and a light syrup remains.

instructions.1: Pour approximately 4 cups of water for every 1/2 kg of dried fruit.
instructions.2: Add 4 tablespoons of sugar or adjust to taste.
instructions.3: Simmer over low heat and add the dried fruit until tender.
instructions.4: Once removed from heat, add the vanilla, nuts, raisins, and coconut.

des-42.title: Prune and Apricot Khoshaf with Figs and Dates

instructions.1: Place enough water in a pot to cover the prunes and apricots, and add the sugar.
instructions.2: Add the prunes and simmer over low heat until they are half-cooked.
instructions.3: Add the apricots to the prunes and cook until fully tender, ensuring neither the prunes nor the apricots fall apart, adding water as needed.
instructions.4: Remove from heat, sprinkle a little vanilla into the remaining liquid once the fruit is cooked, and transfer to a serving bowl.
instructions.5: Add the sliced dried figs and the sliced pitted dried dates, then cover and leave to cool.
instructions.6: Garnish with raisins and nuts.

instructions.1: Mix the cornstarch thoroughly with two tablespoons of the cold milk.
instructions.2: Boil the remaining milk and pour it over the cornstarch mixture while stirring rapidly off the heat.
instructions.3: Place the mixture over low heat and boil while stirring for about 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Sweeten with sugar, remove from heat, and set aside to cool.
instructions.5: Whisk the egg with the vanilla thoroughly, then add it to the cooled mixture.
instructions.6: Place in the freezer using an ice cream maker, ice cube trays, or any plastic mold and leave until frozen.
instructions.7: Remove from the freezer, stir well, and then refreeze.

des-44.title: Layered Ice Cream and Savoy Biscuit Cake

db45-2.name: Savoy biscuits
db45-2.standardAmount: as needed for the ice cream amount

instructions.1: Melt the ready-made ice cream in a stainless steel tray and let it partially freeze.
instructions.2: Remove from the freezer and layer the Savoy biscuits over the ice cream according to the quantity used.
instructions.3: Blend the milk with the mixed fruit in a blender and pour the mixture into the tray.
instructions.4: Sprinkle the crushed nuts and coconut over the mixture.
instructions.5: Add another layer of ice cream on top of the mixture and place in the freezer until frozen.
instructions.6: When serving, place the tray over hot water vapor just until it wobbles slightly, then scoop into serving dishes or small molds.

des-45.title: Mango Ice Cream with Chantilly Cream

instructions.1: Combine the milk, sugar, and juice, then blend with an electric mixer until smooth.
instructions.2: Add the chantilly cream powder to the mixture and whip with the mixer until well combined.
instructions.3: Pour into a mold and place in the freezer.

instructions.1: Whisk the eggs and yolks together well in a bowl.
instructions.2: Boil the milk and add the grated chocolate, stirring until completely melted.
instructions.3: Add the sugar to the mixture.
instructions.4: Pour the warm mixture over the whisked eggs in the bowl and mix well with a whisk.
instructions.5: Pour the mixture into an ice cream maker and run the machine until it is well chilled in the freezer.
instructions.6: Whisk the chantilly cream thoroughly with an electric mixer, then add it to the mixture in the machine and run until frozen.
instructions.7: A mold can be used as an alternative to an ice cream machine.

instructions.1: Combine sugar and water in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly until the sugar dissolves and becomes a light syrup.
instructions.2: Whisk the egg yolks thoroughly until the mixture is light and frothy.
instructions.3: Gradually and slowly pour the syrup into the whisked egg yolks while whisking constantly until combined and cooled; then add salt and vanilla while continuing to whisk, followed by adding the cream and whisking everything together well.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture into an ice cream maker or into molds and place in the freezer until frozen.

instructions.1: Combine the sugar with one-third of the water in a small saucepan over medium heat until the sugar dissolves, then increase the heat until it boils and turns brown.
instructions.2: Add the remaining water and boil together until it reaches a caramel consistency.
instructions.3: Whisk the egg yolks thoroughly until they turn pale, then add them to the caramel and set aside to cool.
instructions.4: Add the cream to the mixture, stir well, and let it cool.
instructions.5: Pour the mixture into an ice cream mold or machine and place in the freezer for two hours.
instructions.6: Remove from the freezer, whisk well, and return to the freezer until completely frozen.

instructions.1: Mash the peaches, mix with the juice, and cook for 20 minutes until the mixture softens.
instructions.2: Boil the sugar with the water for 5 minutes, then whisk the egg whites and pour them into the hot syrup while stirring constantly, then set aside to cool.
instructions.3: Whip the cream, then add it to the egg and peach mixture and mix well.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture into a deep mold, cover, and place in the freezer until frozen.
instructions.5: When serving, slice into portions and serve with some fresh fruit.

db51-6.name: chopped fruit (cantaloupe, apple, banana) or mixed compote

instructions.1: Prepare the serving bowls by placing a thin layer of cake at the bottom, followed by a light layer of ice cream and a sprinkle of nuts and raisins.
instructions.2: Add another thin layer of chocolate pudding or jelly, then sprinkle with grated chocolate and coconut.
instructions.3: Place 3 small scoops of ice cream on top.
instructions.4: Garnish with chopped fruits such as cantaloupe, apple, banana, or mixed compote.
instructions.5: You can also garnish with scattered pieces of any type of jam.
instructions.6: Place the bowls in the freezer until just before serving time, then move them to the top shelf of the refrigerator.

instructions.1: Boil the water with enough sugar, then add the tamarind after removing from the heat; cover and let soak in the liquid for about 5 hours.
instructions.2: Strain through a wire sieve, then place in the refrigerator.

instructions.1: Prepare a bowl or a deep dish and place the required amount of licorice inside.
instructions.2: Mix the licorice with a very small amount of water using your fingers just to moisten it, then cover and leave for about 5 hours to ferment.
instructions.3: Prepare a pitcher with a wire strainer placed on top, covered with a cheesecloth, then place the moistened licorice paste inside the cloth.
instructions.4: Pour water through the filter drop by drop, or pour water slowly, until the desired color and flavor are achieved.
instructions.5: Place the pitcher in the refrigerator, then strain the mixture through the cloth.

instructions.1: Soak the Qamar al-Din in enough water (preferably hot) for a long period until it is fully hydrated and the water cools.
instructions.2: Blend the apricot mixture and the soaking water in a blender, adding the sugar.
instructions.3: Dilute with more water until the desired consistency is reached.
instructions.4: Pour into a pitcher and refrigerate.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee and toast the mughat powder over low heat until it turns golden yellow.
instructions.2: Remove from heat and gradually add the water while stirring constantly until it reaches a near-desired consistency.
instructions.3: Return to the stove over medium heat, add the sugar, and stir continuously until it reaches a boil.
instructions.4: When serving, add hot sweetened milk if needed.
instructions.5: Sprinkle the top with the crushed toasted hazelnuts and coconut.

instructions.1: Grease a rectangular or round baking pan thoroughly with melted ghee.
instructions.2: Cut the phyllo sheets to the width of the pan.
instructions.3: Layer half of the sheets one by one, brushing a little melted ghee between each layer.
instructions.4: Mix the crushed nuts with raisins and coconut with a little sugar, then spread the mixture in the center; cinnamon may be added to the nuts.
instructions.5: Cover the filling with the remaining sheets using the same method as the first half.
instructions.6: Cut the phyllo into diamond or triangle shapes using a knife.
instructions.7: Pour melted ghee over the surface and bake in a medium-heat oven until golden brown and cooked; then pour cold syrup over it and cover until completely cooled.

instructions.1: Grease a rectangular or round baking pan thoroughly with melted ghee.
instructions.2: Cut the phyllo sheets to fit the width of the pan.
instructions.3: Place half of the sheets one by one into the pan, lightly brushing each layer with warm milk and a little melted ghee.
instructions.4: Add the cream and nut filling.
instructions.5: Cover the filling with the remaining sheets, following the same method used for the first half.
instructions.6: Brush the surface with warm ghee and bake in a medium-heat oven until cooked and golden brown.
instructions.7: Dissolve the sugar in the milk and slowly pour it over the surface of the pan, then turn off the oven and cover the pan.
instructions.8: The cream filling can be replaced with clotted cream (ashta) or custard with nuts.

instructions.1: Grease a rectangular or round baking pan thoroughly with melted ghee.
instructions.2: Cut the phyllo sheets to fit the width of the pan.
instructions.3: Place half of the sheets into the pan one by one, brushing each layer with a little melted ghee.
instructions.4: Spread the almond filling over the layers.
instructions.5: Cover the filling with the remaining sheets, following the same layering method used in the first half.
instructions.6: Melt the remaining ghee, pour it over the top, and bake in a medium-heat oven until golden brown and cooked through.
instructions.7: After removing from the oven, pour the cold syrup over the hot pastry and cover until completely cooled.

instructions.1: Mix the almonds with the sugar and stir in a little water.
instructions.2: Beat the egg well and add it along with the lemon zest and vanilla, then mix the filling thoroughly.

instructions.1: Break up the kunafa pastry into fine strands using your fingers.
instructions.2: Melt half of the ghee and mix it thoroughly with the kunafa.
instructions.3: Grease a tray and spread half of the kunafa mixture in it, then add the filling of chopped nuts, raisins, coconut, and the tablespoon of sugar.
instructions.4: Layer the remaining kunafa on top and press down firmly with your hands.
instructions.5: Drizzle the remaining melted ghee over the surface and bake in a medium-heat oven until the top is golden, then flip it to brown the other side.
instructions.6: Pour the cold syrup over the hot pastry, cover, and let it cool; then garnish with either pistachios or hazelnuts.
